answer: No cask, no cloth, no piece of work is sold until the master has signed the book and the warden has seen the signature. Anchor founder cast record with founders attestation is the signature the buyer relies on: ten-year record, 300 anchors cast, iron accounts, yearly fees. Sell under a borrowed relic and the buyer is refunded in full, the seller pays the same sum again as a fine and the tide is forfeited to the town, while the pulse is filed in the trade book and read at the fair.
